character.note: unchanged; four indexed 128x128 sprites, HUD not in sprite

streak.note: Consecutive days meeting the daily goal; resets to 0 if the goal is not met that day. ASCII only (Press Start 2P has no CJK).

today.note: Replaces Today N. N is completed rounds today; G is today's goal (default 4, changeable on the settings page). N may exceed G.

notes: HUD is drawn by firmware, not baked into character sprites.
Do not move the character, timer, stage label, or online dot.
STANDBY dimming remains backlight / global brightness, not baked into the sprite.
New fields: today goal folded into the existing Today line as Today N/G; streak at top-left as ND (e.g. 5D).
